infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NSA accesses the camera only when you explicitly start an approved live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NSA accesses the microphone only when you explicitly start an approved live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NSA uses your location only when you explicitly request it during an SOS event so you can tell emergency responders where you are.
